latHint: Think what puts out a fire.
pivHint: Micah says to WALK humbly with your God. In the Gospels, Jesus amazed his disciples when he chose to WALK on ______.
winText: You found it. WALK isn't just how we follow God humbly. Jesus also chose to WALK on WATER.
lossText: The word was WATER. WALK was the pivot. In Matthew 14, Jesus amazed his disciples by WALKing on WATER.
votdVerse: He has shown you, O mortal, what is good. And what does the Lord require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
passageText: With what shall I come before the Lord and bow down before the exalted God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves a year old? Will the Lord be pleased with thousands of rams, with ten thousand rivers of olive oil? Shall I offer my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul? He has shown you, O mortal, what is good. And what does the Lord require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
